figurative_meaning_en: In trouble due to one's actions; twist of events; as a result of conspiracy
similar_in_english: Caught in a web of intrigue
example_sentences_in_english: His life has been caught in a coil of conspiracy.
This incident is entirely the result of intrigue.
note: এটি একটি যুগ্মশব্দ যা ষড়যন্ত্রের ধারণা প্রকাশ করে, জিলিপির পাকের সাথে তুলনীয়।
